Id.description:
A 128-bit identifier. It is written as the usual hyphenated UUID text in
every encoding, so CBOR, JSON, and file names all show the same string.

ManifestEntry.description: One line of the manifest: a file, its hash, and its record version.

path.description: Path relative to the identity root, with `/` separators.

Timestamp.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

Tombstone.description:
A file the store once held and has since removed (D29). The chain keeps
saying what was there, so a removal is a recorded step, not a gap, and
a copy of the file put back is an unlisted file and refused.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the file's last bytes.

path.description: The path the file had, relative to the identity root.

description:
The signed, hash-chained list of every file in the store (§5). A reader
that remembers the newest manifest it accepted can tell a rollback.

prev.description: SHA-256 of the previous manifest's bytes; empty for the first.

seq.description: Rises by one on every write.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature by the ISK over the record with `sig` empty.

tombstones.description:
Every file that was removed, oldest first (D29). Empty until the
first removal, and then left out of the encoding.

title: Manifest
